notes.title: A Pinch of Magic, our new slice of life dating sim, has released!
notes.content:
Enamored Risks was our NaNoRenO (annual visual novel game jam) entry for 2020 and we hope you all have enjoyed it! This year for NaNoRenO we created A Pinch of Magic, a short modern fantasy dating sim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225553/0d166dc0d080717da03a4c2f65e85af6e75238a3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225553/8618299226a834e5b8a18d13062c71bae25c5c07.png[/img]

Varsha is a young witch who has just graduated high school. While their friends were off jet setting and travelling around the world, Varsha had to go back to their hometown Lynnsdale to take care of their grandparents who ran a small magic store. There were two major issues though: one, magic is strictly banned and two, their grandparents store is on the verge of bankruptcy.

[h3]Play as Varsha as you try to revive your grandparent's store, avoid scrutiny by the authorities, and find love—all in one summer.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1587180/A_Pinch_of_Magic/

If you want a quick slice of life dating sim, check out A Pinch of Magic! If you enjoy it, you can read how it was developed on our [url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/a-pinch-of-magic/][b]website devlogs[/b][/url]. Thank you for playing our visual novels!

notes.title: Enjoyed Enamored Risks? Read how it was made!
notes.content:
It's been a while since Enamored Risks was released, and we're glad to see that so many people have been having fun playing it! For anyone curious about the making of Enamored Risks, we have a collection of devlogs from those who worked on it:

[url=https://crystalgameworks.com/category/enamored-risks/][h1]Read the devlogs here![/h1][/url]

There's several devlogs for Enamored Risks on our website above that include topics like [b]writing direction[/b], [b]CG design[/b], [b]creating backgrounds[/b], and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225553/9ec536876e7b7385a355b22c2220333f3b2bc8a0.png[/img]

Additionally if you haven't checked them out already, we post some extra Enamored Risks content on our Twitter and Instagram accounts:

If you want to chat with others about the game, otome games in general, or just hang out, you can also join our Discord server!

[url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225553/a78e74fe3a7a40aa6245948b2dabb16f6a88ee64.png[/img][/url]

— foleso

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Enamored Risks is now released! 🎉[/h1]

Our newest otome / girls love visual novel is now here! This game was made by a great team of volunteers for the NaNoRenO game jam, so the entire game was made in about a month and a half. This couldn't have been finished without everyone putting in so much time and dedication, and we're really thankful for everyone who was onboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37225553/49b757205c2c4f64fa7c1dbb7686afa675bf08db.jpg[/img]

We hope you guys will like this- feel free to join our Discord server or @ us on Twitter and tell us what route is your favorite!
